title: UK government updates rules for giving evidence from abroad
excerpt: The updated country guidance details rules for video testimony in UK tribunals for Burkina Faso and Myanmar.
bodyHtml:
The UK government announced on November 4, 2026, that it updated its guidance regarding giving evidence from abroad to UK tribunals. The updates modify rules for Burkina Faso and Myanmar to reflect new regulations for those countries.

The country-by-country guidance explains whether individuals can provide evidence by video link from each country in a UK tribunal case. It also details which kinds of tribunals permit this method and what individuals must do before giving evidence.

If a specific country is not listed in the guidance, the government directs individuals to contact the Taking of Evidence Team at the Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office or reach out to the relevant tribunal directly.
